analysis_scope.scope_policy: External manager entries are analyzed as external symbols without importing implementation bodies or inferring gameplay semantics from API names.

cause_findings.cause: The 488-row reconciliation is an external-only live-manager difference, not a canonical function deficit.
cause_findings.finding: The requested interval is exact and contiguous: 122 unique EXTERNAL entries, all marked external and noncanonical.

cause_findings.cause: The committed external allowlist has no matching record for those source identities.
cause_findings.finding: 106 rows have allowlisted identity and 16 have null identity; the 16 null rows cannot be mapped to EXT-token xrefs.

cause_findings.cause: The xref export encodes external references with EXT:<token>; source zero and token-keyed xrefs measure different endpoint representations.
cause_findings.finding: All 122 source rows report external_xref_count=0 and no committed xref edge uses an EXTERNAL:<address> endpoint; 1,014 token-keyed external edges are available for the 106 named rows.

cause_findings.cause: The reconciliation exposes external manager entries and identities, not executable bodies or implementation metadata for those entries.
cause_findings.finding: Function body size, section, and block are null/not applicable; thunk is unavailable, and stub/generated status is not established for all 122 rows.

cause_findings.cause: Name equality is not address equality; no duplicate function identity is established.
cause_findings.finding: Seven named rows have same-name matches in the canonical function export, but all have zero canonical VA overlap and remain distinct external manager entries.

cause_findings.cause: External namespace, DLL identity, and API names are linkage evidence only; no function-level gameplay contract, decompilation, or runtime evidence is present.
cause_findings.finding: Gameplay relevance is not established for every row.

derivation.body_size: Preserve source null and report not applicable because an external manager entry has no committed implementation body.
derivation.classification: Classify external boundary, thunk, stub, generated, and runtime status only from namespace, flags, allowlist identity, and committed export evidence; do not infer behavior from names.

derivation.section_block: Preserve source null and report not applicable because no EXTERNAL function row exists in the canonical function export.
